name: NUPHAR LUTEUM
gi_symptoms: Entero-colitis. Yellow diarrhœa; worse in the morning. Diarrhœa during typhoid.
urinary_symptoms: Complete absence of sexual desire; parts relaxed; penis retracted. Impotency, with involuntary emissions during stool, when urinating. Spermatorrhœa. Pain in testicles and penis.

source.title: NUPHAR LUTEUM - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
